title: Nogai Horde
capsule: The Nogai Horde was a confederation of Turkic and Mongol tribes that broke away from the Golden Horde in the mid-15th century, occupying the steppe between the Volga and Ural rivers north of the Caspian Sea. Ruled by beys descended from Edigu, it was a powerful nomadic state through the 16th century before fragmenting under Russian and Kalmyk pressure.
